content.title: Anti-inflammatory drugs
content.recommendation: Low-dose colchicine (0.5 mg once daily) may be considered, particularly if other risk factors are insufficiently controlled or if recurrent cardiovascular disease events occur under optimal therapy.
footnotes: Increase statin potency/dose if the patient was on low-potency/low-dose statin, add ezetimibe if the patient was only on statins at highest tolerated dose, or add PCSK9 inhibitor if the patient was on statins plus ezetimibe.
Angiotensin receptor blockers in cases of intolerance.

Associated Conditions: Residual cardiovascular risk despite statin/ezetimibe therapy
genes.context: Listed in abbreviations as proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 and referenced in footnote recommending adding a PCSK9 inhibitor if LDL-C remains high despite statin plus ezetimibe.
